uncited: For each camera $c \in \mathcal{B}_t$, iterate over all blocks $k \in \mathcal{K}$.
Perform a 6-plane frustum test against the block's bounding sphere $(c_k, r_k)$.
A sphere is culled if it lies entirely outside any frustum plane.
If the sphere intersects the frustum (not culled), add $k$ to the active set $\mathcal{K}_t$.
